<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042024-09-2410-28-16" status="unreviewed">2 pa tshad mas sgro 'dogs ji ltar gcod pa'i tshul ni ¦ <lb n="4b5"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">chos rje</rs>s ¦<quote source="db:6664" n="VIII.46ab"> <l>tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa 'dren ||</l>
         <l>nges pa'i 'gal zla sgro 'dogs yin ||</l></quote> 
         zhes bya ba ltar | kun du tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i stobs kyis 'jug ldog byed pa na nges shes 'dren dgos te
        <quote> <l>yod med nges pa'i 'bras can min || </l> <l>phyir na tshad ma nyid mi 'gyur || </l></quote>(PV I.200ab) zhes bya bas so || <note type="editorial">=RTRG ad RT VIII.46ab</note>
         de ltar tshad ma'i grangs pa'i nges shes des <lb n="4b6"/> sgro 'dogs gcod pa yin te |
         <quote n="PV I.49"><l>nges pa dang ni sgro 'dogs yid || </l>
         <l>gnod bya gnod byed ngo bo'i phyir ||</l>
         <l>'di ni sgro 'dogs dben pa la || </l>
         <l>'jug ces bya bar shes pa yin || </l></quote>
zhes bya bas so ||
des na mngon sum gyis sgro 'dogs gcod ces brjod kyang mngon sum min gyi, rjes kyi nges pa gcod pa yin te, ku sha lag pas bzung nas zor bas gcod pa bzhin no || <note type="editorial">=RTRG ad VIII.49ab</note>
<lb n="4b7"/> 'di dag gi don nges par bya ba la gcad bya sgro 'dogs kyi rang bzhin ¦ gcod byed nges pa'i rang bzhin ni: des ji ltar sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i tshul 3 gyis nges par byed par gsung kyang, rtogs sla zhing | 'og nas rtog pa'i rab dbye'i skabs su yang 'chad pas na 'dir ma spros so ||</seg></TEI>
